PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against GDP/WHO cold chain standards. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — cold chain integrity rate trending toward 99.5% compliance. Escalate if <97% compliance floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using WHO/GDP cold chain guidelines. Report to Cold Chain Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 30 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >7 consecutive days, escalate to a global supply chain strategy director for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 7 days.
